content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, digital creators face significant barriers to selling their products. This guide outlines how to build a fully operational crypto store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-every-5|COREMERCH guide to github]].io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-what-actually-how-12|Cloudflare Workers]]-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-21|cloudflare]] Pages, leveraging reliable infrastructure that enables seamless transactions without relying on traditional payment platforms. You will learn to deploy Stack 02, which offers comprehensive features and robust testing, ensuring your digital storefront is ready for business in just 48 hours.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Current payment platforms often exclude creators from specific regions, hampering their ability to monetize their digital products. COREMERCH provides a solution that enables complete ownership and control over your online store. With infrastructure sovereignty, you can deploy a stack that operates independently of third-party platforms, ensuring your revenue stream remains uninterrupted. The combination of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments creates a resilient architecture, allowing you to process payments securely and automatically, regardless of geographic restrictions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before starting your deployment, gather the essential tools and resources. You need a Cloudflare account, access to Supabase for database management, and a NOWPayments account to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Additionally, prepare your digital products—such as ebooks, courses, or templates—and have them ready to upload. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint documentation provided by COREMERCH, which will guide you through each step of the setup process. These preparations will expedite your deployment and ensure a smooth transition to your new crypto store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment system through NOWPayments. Create a project in Cloudflare and set up your Workers to handle backend logic. Connect Supabase to manage your orders and customer data effectively. Ensure that you configure automatic webhook notifications for payment confirmations. Next, upload your digital products to your designated storage solution, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This setup allows you to automate product delivery upon payment verification, enhancing customer experience while you maintain full ownership of the infrastructure.
Infrastructure sovereignty means you control your digital store without reliance on third-party platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it's time to go live. Deploy your configuration on Cloudflare Pages and verify that your Workers are functioning correctly. Conduct a series of tests to ensure that payments are processed smoothly through NOWPayments. Once you’re confident in the setup, promote your store by sharing the link to your products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Monitor the first transactions closely to ensure everything operates as expected. This phase is crucial for identifying any issues before scaling your operations.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your crypto store operational, focus on scaling your business effectively. Utilize the tools provided in the Sovereign Blueprint to add more products and enhance your marketing strategies. Consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) if you need more advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations for email delivery and improved security. Continuously analyze customer feedback and transaction data to optimize your offerings. Expanding your store's capabilities will allow you to reach a wider audience while maintaining complete control over your digital commerce.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize infrastructure tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments. By following the Sovereign Blueprint, you can deploy a fully functional store without relying on conventional payment platforms. This setup ensures you maintain full ownership and control over your revenue stream.
Deploying Stack 02 guarantees an end-to-end tested environment delivered within 48 hours.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
